lines.text: Jeremiah tells the LORD he is mocked all day long, and his message is violence and destruction.
When Jeremiah tries to stop speaking in the LORD's name, His message becomes a fire burning in his heart.
Jeremiah's trusted friends watch for his fall, but the LORD is with him like a fearsome shepherd.
Jeremiah commits his cause to the LORD of Hosts and says the LORD rescues the life of the wealthy.
Jeremiah curses the day he was born and asks why he left the womb to see only trouble and sorrow.
